title: hm-notes-page, version 1
description: The contents of one page of a notebook: its items, from the bottom to the top (docs/formats/hm-notes-page.md, sdk-core ADR 0045). Positions and sizes are whole units, 100 to a PDF point. Beyond this schema, the reader checks that item ids are unique on the page, that a stroke's points are x, y, pressure triples with each pressure from 0 to 1,000, and that no text holds a lone surrogate. A page is read on its own, so the reader doesn't check that a link's page or an anchor's recording is in the notebook.

id.description: The page's id, as its notebook lists it.

items.description: The items, from the bottom to the top: up to 1,000,000.

id.description: An identifier: 1 to 64 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -.

duration.description: A length of time, in whole milliseconds.

position.description: A position, in whole units from the page's top-left corner, with y growing downwards. There are 100 units to a PDF point. An item may reach up to 1,440,000 units outside its page.

length.description: A width or a height, in whole units, from 1.

assetName.description: A file's name: sha256: and the SHA-256 of its bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

imageAsset.description: A reference to a picture's file. SVG is never one: it can carry scripts.

audioAnchor.description: When an item was written during a recording, so playback can follow it.

recording.description: The recording's id, in the notebook's recordings.

tool.description: A pen's stroke follows pressure. A highlighter's is translucent, and drawn under the pen's.

size.description: The stroke's width at full pressure, in units: 0.1 to 72 points.

points.description: The pen's path as flat x, y, pressure triples: 1 to 20,000 of them. x and y are positions in units. Pressure is from 0 to 1,000. A schema can't say that the count is a multiple of three, or bound every third number on its own: the reader checks both.

uniform.description: Present for a stroke of one width from end to end, whose pressures are ignored. Never false.

text.description: A box of typed text. Its text wraps at the box's width, and its height follows from the text.
The text: up to 20,000 Unicode code points, with no lone surrogate. It's drawn as text, never interpreted as markup.

size.description: The font size, in units: 4 to 288 points.

image.description: A picture placed on the page.

link.description: An area of a page that leads to another page of the same notebook.

page.description: The id of the page it leads to.

item.description: Anything on a page, over its paper.
